pgjdbc/pgjdbc: PostgreSQL JDBC driver (Java 8+ at runtime). Users configure it with connection properties. User documentation lives in docs/ (a Hugo site: connection properties, supported Java and PostgreSQL versions, features). CHANGELOG.md is updated in the pull request for every user-visible change. JMH benchmarks are in benchmarks/. Security-sensitive code: authentication (SCRAM, GSS, SSPI), SSL/TLS, and parsing of the PostgreSQL wire protocol in pgjdbc/src/main/java/org/postgresql/core. Translations of error messages are .po files.
uber/NullAway: NullAway, an Error Prone plugin that checks nullness at compile time; many users run it in large builds, so its speed and false positives matter. Users configure it with -XepOpt:NullAway:* flags documented in README.md and the project wiki. JSpecify mode implements the JSpecify specification of generics and nullness. CHANGELOG.md is written by maintainers at release time. JMH benchmarks are in jmh/. Library models (library-model/, jdk-annotations) describe third-party APIs.
apache/calcite: Apache Calcite, a SQL parser, validator, and query optimizer framework embedded by many projects; its public Java API and generated SQL for many dialects are relied upon. Documentation lives in site/_docs: reference.md (SQL reference), adapter pages, howto.md (building, testing and releasing Calcite), and history.md (release notes, written at release time). Every pull request title carries a CALCITE-NNNN Jira key. JMH benchmarks are in ubenchmark/.
